title: I have created bots
author: csparty88
selftext:
I've been building bots that do market research and surface options plays swing trades and 0DTE setups. I run a Telegram channel that sends the calls out every morning at 8:25 AM CST.

I use it myself, and no, it's not perfect I still take losses sometimes. Right now I'm paper trading to see how it actually performs before I put more size behind it.

Last month it flagged a DELL setup that, on paper, would've been a solid $20K winner if I'd actually taken the trade. Wish I had, but that's the point of paper trading first building confidence before real money's on the line.
